title: Bo-Katan Kryze
subtitle: Princess in Exile
text: Action [Exhaust]: If you attacked with a Mandalorian unit this phase, deal 1 damage to a unit.
deployBox: On Attack: You may deal 1 damage to a unit. If you attacked with another Mandalorian unit this phase, you may deal 1 damage to a unit. (The same unit or a different unit.)
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Bo-Katan’s leader ability still can be used as an action even if you didn’t attack with a Mandalorian unit this phase (but it doesn’t deal damage).
Bo-Katan’s “On Attack” ability deals 2 instances of damage. If both instances of instances of damage are dealt to a unit with a Shield token, the Shield will only prevent the first damage.
(ERRATA) On Attack: You may deal 1 damage to a unit. Then, if you attacked with another Mandalorian unit this phase, you may deal 1 damage to a unit. (The same unit or a different unit.)
